create_access_group: create a new access group with teams, keys, models, and MCP server assignments
list_access_groups: list all access groups ordered by creation date descending
get_access_group: get a specific access group by its unique access group ID
update_access_group: update an existing access group with new teams, keys, or model assignments
delete_access_group: delete an access group and remove its references from all associated teams and keys
